title: Pre-Gate Advisory Snapshot
description: Deterministic bundle-only pre-gate advisory snapshot artifact for candidate-agnostic research review.

pre_gate_advisory_snapshot_id.description: Stable pre-gate advisory snapshot artifact identifier.

generated_at.description: Timezone-qualified ISO datetime deterministically derived as the latest source generated_at timestamp.

as_of_timestamp.description: Timezone-qualified ISO datetime deterministically derived as the latest source as_of_timestamp.

source_agent_output_id.description: Stable source Regime/Scoring agent-output artifact identifier.

source_bucket_mapping_id.description: Stable source advisory bucket-mapping artifact identifier.

source_macro_window_agent_output_id.description: Stable source macro-window agent-output artifact identifier.

setup_score.description: Bounded setup score copied from the source Regime/Scoring agent output.

confidence.description: Bounded confidence copied from the source Regime/Scoring agent output.

mapped_bucket.description: Bounded advisory bucket copied from the source bucket mapping artifact.

size_multiplier.description: Advisory size multiplier copied from the source bucket mapping artifact.

macro_window_flag.description: Deterministic macro-window advisory flag copied from the source macro-window agent output.

deterministic.description: Whether the bundle was produced deterministically from committed repo artifacts only.

advisory_only.description: Whether the bundle has no overlay, OMS, risk, runtime, or execution authority.

combination_rule_applied.description: Explicit statement that no lane-combination rule has been applied.

notes.description: Boundary notes; must describe bundle-only semantics and no policy, overlay, OMS, risk, runtime, or execution authority.
